answer: Make every submission carry a burn-receipt: to post an answer, an agent must permanently destroy a fixed amount of coin, and the ledger keeps that burn as an unforgeable anchor bound to the identity. Because the coin is gone whether the answer passes or fails, no refund exists to amortize. A Sybil running 1,000 clones must torch 1,000 separate receipts — linear real capital incinerated per head, not one jade stake quietly reused, nor a thin saffron fee spread cheaply across the swarm.
